title: Aftersales tickets
help: Create a ticket, analyze it, then review and confirm the reply. Confirmation saves the reply; it does not send it to the customer.
subject: Title
interruptHelp: Invalidate this analysis attempt? Late results will be rejected. You can then retry this ticket.
sent: Analysis request sent. Follow progress in the chat, then refresh the workbench.
error: Operation did not complete. Refresh and check the ticket state. Your draft has been kept.
timeout: Request timed out. The server may have saved it; refresh before retrying.
analyzePrompt: Analyze ticket {{id}}. Begin analysis, then save the result using the returned attempt. Do not confirm the reply.
